summary: The patch adds only documentation and tests; it introduces no source defect, and the tested same-origin RPC behavior already exists at the base commit.

evidence: At base, `src/worker.ts` lines 92-94 route every `/rpc/*` request to `handleRpc` before any `VPS_ORIGIN_MAP` host lookup.
`handleRpc` builds `https://rpc.ubq.fi/${chainId}${url.search}` and forwards method and body, so arbitrary and nested proxied hosts already receive same-origin RPC behavior.
The base implementation also answers `OPTIONS` locally with CORS headers, and this candidate changes only README guidance plus tests for that existing behavior.
